summary: Completed the initial scenario-complete review of Amazon.com, Inc. after its July 30 volume anomaly and July 31 post-results upper-Bollinger and bullish-MACD transitions. Current SEC-filed Q2 evidence shows 20% sales growth, 43% operating-income growth, and 37% AWS growth. The July 31 move is a positive earnings-driven repricing, while the prior-session volume anomaly remains unexplained by a contemporaneous filing. A mature-compounder earnings-multiple valuation gives USD 200/270/360 bear/base/bull values, 1.2593% expected return, and 0.9445% confidence-adjusted expected return. Negative base return, weak downside payoff, negative trailing free cash flow, AI capital intensity, and the absent accepted relationship make the assessment ineligible and watch-rated. No conviction strategy or idea refresh was created.

evidence.claim: Amazon's SEC-filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 200.606 billion of quarterly net sales, USD 27.461 billion of operating income, USD 161.403 billion of trailing operating cash flow, and a USD 7.604 billion trailing free-cash-flow outflow. Cash and marketable securities totaled USD 122.988 billion, long-term debt was USD 128.894 billion, long-term lease liabilities were USD 94.338 billion, 10.783 billion common shares were outstanding at quarter-end, and 244.4 million restricted stock units remained outstanding.

The SEC-hosted Q2 release reports 20% consolidated sales growth, 43% operating-income growth, and 37% AWS sales growth. North America, International, and AWS operating income was USD 9.1 billion, USD 1.7 billion, and USD 16.6 billion. Reported net income included USD 53.4 billion of non-operating pre-tax income primarily from Anthropic, and Q3 guidance calls for USD 197-202 billion of sales and USD 22.5-26.5 billion of operating income.
